# laravelcloud_database_schema (Data Source)

Reads an existing Laravel Cloud database schema by ID. Useful when composing modules that reference a schema provisioned in a separate state OR via the Cloud dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads an existing Laravel Cloud database schema by ID.

data "laravelcloud_database_schema" "identity_prd" {
  id = "dbs_01HAM..."
}

output "identity_prd_schema_name" {
  value = data.laravelcloud_database_schema.identity_prd.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cloud-assigned database schema ID (ULID).

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the parent database cluster.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of schema creation.
- `name` (String) Logical database name inside the cluster.
- `status` (String) Cloud lifecycle status.
